authority.commit_route: JSON-RPC :8787 or MCP :8764 through the shared authority boundary

invariants: component children resolve inside the app scope
app-local @key_grammar rows are scoped to and owned by the app manifest
editing app settings updates only that app manifest, never the global base manifest
programs lower into the shared JSON program dispatcher
imports are references and are never copied into component identity
state supplied by a caller is request-scoped and is not persisted
a mini-app cannot self-declare semantic commit authority
optional extensions cannot grant permissions beyond the app manifest or host policy
